description: Saves one workspace rule for how messages read, in the user's words: tone, wording, language, what never to claim, price, links, what to say first (e.g. "nunca fale de preço na primeira mensagem", "sempre em português", "não cite concorrentes"). Every cadence written afterwards follows it; existing cadences change only when rewritten. The number of steps, their days and channels are campaign settings, not rules. Free.

rule.description: The rule as the user said it, one sentence. Keep where it applies when they said it ("nas frias", "na campanha X").

name: add_cadence_rule
title: Acrescentar regra de cadência
